name: miaomiao-notes
description: A cute, local-first Markdown notes app for macOS, synced through iCloud Drive. 一只喵喵的本地 Markdown 笔记应用，通过 iCloud Drive 同步。
author: Martin

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run dist:arm64 && npm run dist:x64 && npm run clean
scripts.dist:ulmo: npm run dist:arm64 && node scripts/compress-dmg.cjs arm64 && npm run dist:x64 && node scripts/compress-dmg.cjs x64 && npm run clean
